import re, json, math, time
email='as_moore@gmail.com'
password=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw=[x['password'] for x in password if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
print('spotify_pw_len',len(spotify_pw))
login_res=apis.spotify.login(username=email,password=spotify_pw)
print(login_res)
access_token=login_res['access_token']

# Fetch all liked playlists and collect unique song_ids
try:
    token=access_token
except NameError:
    email='as_moore@gmail.com'
    spotify_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
    token=apis.spotify.login(username=email,password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

page_index=0
page_limit=20
song_ids=set()
playlist_ids=[]
all_playlists=[]

while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # res could be list or dict
    if isinstance(res, dict) and 'message' in res:
        print('error',res)
        break
    if not res:
        break
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(res))
    for p in res:
        playlist_ids.append(p.get('playlist_id'))
        all_playlists.append(p)
        for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]) or []:
            song_ids.add(int(sid))
    page_index+=1

print('total_playlists',len(all_playlists))
print('unique_song_ids',len(song_ids))
print('sample_song_ids',sorted(list(song_ids))[:10])

# Rate all songs appearing in liked playlists to 5 stars (update existing ratings lower)
email='as_moore@gmail.com'
token=access_token
song_ids_sorted=sorted(list(song_ids))
print('songs_to_process',len(song_ids_sorted))

stats={'already_5':0,'updated':0,'created':0,'had_no_review_page':0}
per_song_actions=[]

for idx,sid in enumerate(song_ids_sorted):
    # Fetch all reviews by this user for the song (paginate)
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    user_reviews=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=int(sid), user_email=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if isinstance(res, dict) and 'message' in res:
            print('error show_song_reviews',sid,res)
            break
        if not res:
            break
        user_reviews.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    # Determine actions
    if not user_reviews:
        # Create review rating 5
        rr=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=int(sid), rating=5, access_token=token)
        stats['created']+=1
        per_song_actions.append((sid,'created',rr.get('song_review_id')))
        print('created review for song',sid,'review_id',rr.get('song_review_id'))
    else:
        # Update any review with rating <5
        updated_any=False
        for rev in user_reviews:
            rating=float(rev.get('rating',0) or 0)
            if rating<5:
                ur=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=int(rev['song_review_id']), access_token=token, rating=5)
                stats['updated']+=1
                updated_any=True
                per_song_actions.append((sid,'updated',rev['song_review_id'],rating))
        if updated_any:
            print('updated song',sid,'reviews_count',len(user_reviews))
        else:
            stats['already_5']+=1
            per_song_actions.append((sid,'already_5',user_reviews[0]['song_review_id']))
            print('already 5 for song',sid,'reviews_count',len(user_reviews))

print('stats',stats)
print('first_actions',per_song_actions[:10])
